subsystems.name: Coronagraph optics
subsystems.role: blocks the star's light inside the telescope so a faint companion can survive next to it.

subsystems.name: Wavefront control
subsystems.role: measures and cancels the optical errors that leak starlight past the mask.
parts: deformable mirror with thousands of actuators

subsystems.name: Telescope and thermal stability
subsystems.role: provides an aperture big enough to resolve the planet, and holds still for hours.

subsystems.name: Starshade and formation flying
subsystems.role: a separate petal-shaped occulter tens of thousands of kilometres ahead shadows the aperture, doing the suppression before light enters the optics.

subsystems.name: Spectrograph and post-processing
subsystems.role: turns a faint dot into an atmospheric measurement.

buildSteps.title: Polish the mirror
buildSteps.detail: The primary mirror is figured and polished to a smoothness measured in fractions of a nanometre, because any roughness scatters starlight exactly where the planet sits.

buildSteps.title: Build the coronagraph
buildSteps.detail: Masks, stops and a deformable mirror with thousands of actuators are mounted in the optical train, all inside a vacuum enclosure.

buildSteps.title: Close the control loop
buildSteps.detail: A wavefront sensor feeds the deformable mirror many times per second, shaping the mirror surface to cancel scattered starlight.

buildSteps.title: Prove the contrast on the ground
buildSteps.detail: The whole chain is tested in a vacuum testbed with a fake star, until suppression reaches better than a billion to one at a fraction of an arcsecond.

buildSteps.title: Launch and stabilise
buildSteps.detail: The telescope unfolds, its sunshade keeps it thermally still, and pointing is held to milliarcsecond precision for hours.

buildSteps.title: Fly the starshade
buildSteps.detail: If one is used: the occulter is manufactured with a precisely shaped petal edge, separated from the telescope by tens of thousands of kilometres, and held there to metre-level alignment by thrusters and optical metrology.

buildSteps.title: Integrate and subtract
buildSteps.detail: The star is pointed behind the mask, exposures are stacked for hours, and residual starlight is removed using the planet's orbital motion and reference images.

buildSteps.title: Take a spectrum
buildSteps.detail: Planet light is dispersed to look for water, oxygen, methane and carbon dioxide — the signature of a temperate atmosphere.

prerequisites.tech: Deformable mirrors with thousands of actuators
prerequisites.why: suppressing starlight demands shaping the wavefront with very fine control.
demonstrated in laboratory vacuum testbeds, but not yet in a flight environment.

prerequisites.tech: Contrast of about one part in ten billion at small angular separation
prerequisites.why: testbeds have demonstrated roughly a billion-fold suppression in vacuum; the ten-billion-fold level needed for an Earth-like planet is not yet achieved in space.
holding an occulter to metre-level alignment tens of thousands of kilometres from a telescope has never been flown.
JWST's coronagraphs and ground-based extreme adaptive optics exist, but no facility is built for this contrast and stability.

pathway.milestone: space coronagraphs such as JWST's, and ground-based extreme-adaptive-optics instruments, image young hot giant planets
pathway.unlocks: proof that coronagraphy works, and the first spectra of directly imaged planets.

pathway.milestone: a dedicated coronagraph technology demonstration in orbit (the Roman Space Telescope's Coronagraph Instrument)
pathway.unlocks: flight validation of active wavefront control and post-processing.

pathway.milestone: a large space telescope designed around a coronagraph, of the kind studied as the Habitable Worlds Observatory
pathway.unlocks: contrast and stability good enough to reach temperate, rocky planets.

pathway.milestone: a starshade flown in formation with a telescope
pathway.unlocks: a wider band of wavelengths and easier access to planets close to their star.

pathway.milestone: routine spectra of temperate rocky planets
pathway.unlocks: the search for biosignature gases in other atmospheres.
